A project is a reason to bring several skills together. Begin with a need or clear goal, make enough to learn, test it, and use evidence to decide what to keep, change, remove, or test next.

## Projects you can use now

- [Circuits and Digital Logic project](../../03-digital-logic-inputs/06-circuits-culminating-project.qmd) combines inputs, logic, outputs, diagrams, testing, and explanation.
- [Computer Systems pathway](../../computer-systems/index.qmd) commissions, upgrades, benchmarks, and recommends a classroom computer.
- [Control Systems and CNC](../../05-control-systems/index.qmd) explores feedback, state machines, motors, interlocks, and machine control.
- [Engineering Design Project](../../engineering-preparation-track/index.qmd#engineering-design-project) connects engineering calculations to a tested design.

## Design support

Use the [N.I.C.E. Design Process](../../../design-fabrication/design-process/index.qmd) to identify the need, investigate, communicate an idea, test it, and improve it. The matching slides and handouts are linked from that page.
